Container.Name: stintara-postgres
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 17 database for Stintara. This container is intentionally not exposed on port 5432 and communicates with the Stintara server only through the custom Docker network named stintara.
Container.Requires: Create the custom Docker network first: docker network create stintara

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: Database name. Use the same value in the Stintara server template.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: Database user. Use the same value in the Stintara server template.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Set a long random database password. Enter the same password in the Stintara server template.
